Plot taxonomic composition

Source: R/mp_taxa.R
mp_taxa.Rd

Visualises community composition at a chosen taxonomic rank as stacked bars, smoothed area charts, heatmaps or bubble plots. The top top.n taxa are shown individually and the remainder are collapsed into an "Other" category with a muted colour.

Usage

mp_taxa(
  object,
  tax.level = "Phylum",
  plot.type = c("bar", "area", "heatmap", "bubble", "treemap"),
  group.by = NULL,
  top.n = 10,
  relative = TRUE,
  order.by = "abundance",
  cluster.samples = FALSE,
  other.label = "Other",
  palette = NULL,
  theme = NULL,
  ...,
  plot.title = NULL,
  plot.subtitle = NULL,
  plot.caption = NULL,
  font.size = getOption("micropubr.font.size", 11),
  interactive = FALSE,
  return.data = FALSE,
  verbose = getOption("micropubr.verbose", FALSE)
)

Arguments

object

A phyloseq::phyloseq object.

tax.level

Taxonomic rank to agglomerate to (e.g. "Phylum", "Genus"). Must be one of phyloseq::rank_names().

plot.type

One of "bar", "area", "heatmap", "bubble" or "treemap" (the latter requires the treemapify package).

group.by

Optional metadata column to facet samples by.

top.n

Number of most-abundant taxa to display individually.

relative

Show relative abundance (TRUE) or raw counts.

order.by

How to order samples on the x-axis: a metadata column name, "abundance" (by the most dominant taxon, the default), or "cluster" (hierarchical clustering on Bray-Curtis distances). Ignored when cluster.samples = TRUE.

cluster.samples

Order samples by hierarchical clustering; shorthand for order.by = "cluster".

other.label

Label for the collapsed low-abundance category.

palette

Palette name or colour vector; defaults to a taxon palette.

theme

A ggplot2 theme; defaults to the active theme (see mp_set_defaults(), otherwise mp_theme_publication()).

...

Additional arguments passed to the primary geom (e.g. ggplot2::geom_col() for bars).

plot.title, plot.subtitle, plot.caption

Optional labels.

font.size

Base font size.

interactive

If TRUE, return an interactive plotly widget instead of a static ggplot (requires plotly). See mp_alpha().

return.data

If TRUE, return the aggregated taxon-by-sample tidy data frame instead of a plot.

verbose

Print the methods used.

Value

A ggplot object, a plotly widget when interactive = TRUE, or a data frame when return.data = TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data(GlobalPatterns, package = "phyloseq")
mp_taxa(GlobalPatterns, tax.level = "Phylum", group.by = "SampleType")
} # }
